title: Sheinbaum Reaffirms Invitation for Pope Leo XIV to Visit Mexico, in Meeting With Cardinal Pietro Parolin
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Enrique Méndez
content:
_This article by Alma E. Muñoz and Enrique Méndez originally appeared in
the[August 5, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/08/05/politica/sheinbaum-
insistira-con-el-secretario-del-vaticano-en-visita-de-leon-xiv-a-mexico),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo insisted to the Vatican's
Secretary of State, Cardinal Pietro Parolin, with whom she met for more than
an hour at the National Palace, that Pope Leo XIV visit Mexico.

At the mañanera, she recalled that she had written a letter with the
invitation at the time, and that on December 12

> "I had the opportunity to speak with the Pope, and now that we are receiving
> this visit, which is very important, we are going to insist on the Pope's
> visit to Mexico."

Beyond what he represents for the Catholic people,** "today the Pope also
represents a vision of a debate we have been having here, related to digital
platforms and Artificial Intelligence (AI)."**

> En Palacio Nacional, recibí al secretario de Estado del Vaticano, Pietro
> Parolin; abordamos temas como la primera encíclica del papa León XIV,
> Magnifica Humanitas, donde plantea que el desarrollo de la inteligencia
> artificial debe estar guiado por criterios éticos, dignidad…
> [pic.twitter.com/HU7yc9S9Zp](https://t.co/HU7yc9S9Zp)
>
> -- Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo (@Claudiashein) [August 5,
> 2026](https://x.com/Claudiashein/status/2085069678221627426?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

She stressed that the encyclical **Magnifica Humanitas** , on AI, "**is a
global reference point for a debate about who controls those platforms, who
defines the content, how the algorithms are designed, and where we are heading
as humanity. It is a very important debate at the planetary level, and in
Mexico we are having it. "**

Thus, "beyond his religious representation, and evidently in Mexico there is a
separation of Church and State, and it will always be so, there is a very
important reference that he is representing in the world with respect to this
reflection. He himself even calls for public regulation of Artificial
Intelligence and for everyone to recognize what the impacts are and who they
are benefiting."

In this way, she maintained,**the Pope "is a point of reference at the
international level on this and many other humanitarian issues, and we are
going to insist that he is warmly invited to our country."** The Pope's
representative arrived at the National Palace at 9:55 and departed at 11:10.
